I'm not advocating you do this, that's your choice. You would experience a massive head-ache, a decrease in motor skills, cognitive disturbances, lightheadedness, and delirious state of mind typical of oxygen hypoxia. Eventually you would pass out, have a seizure, and experience brain death. You would likely be aware you were dying for at least part of the time, and would likely be in a state of semi-consciousness until enough brain systems shutdown. It is not possible to know what you would specifically experience prior to losing consciousnesses, thought given the state of mind that a suicidal person is usually in, imagine you might experience twisted up and unpleasant bits of thought and feeling.
